# WEB-3 · Links and spelling on the new pages

## Found (most important first)

| # | Page | Line | What | Fix |
|---|------|------|------|-----|
| 1 | About | 14 | "meet the team" goes to the old site, `fernhill-old.example/people` | Link to `/team` |
| 2 | About | 22 | "get in touch" goes to the old contact form, `fernhill-old.example/contact-us` | Link to `/contact` |

## Passes

- **Links:** every other link on the eight pages lands on a page that exists — 31 links checked.
- **Spelling:** no mistakes on any of the eight pages.
- **Titles:** each page has a title and a one-line description.

## Note

Visitors with an old bookmark will still reach the old addresses until the redirects are in place (WEB-6). Fixing the
two links above does not replace that.
